sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.content: Define encryption requirements to protect AgentAegis's data confidentiality and integrity.

sections.heading: 2. Data at Rest
sub_items: RESTRICTED and CONFIDENTIAL data must be encrypted at rest
Full disk encryption required on all endpoints
Database encryption (TDE or field-level) for sensitive data

sections.heading: 3. Data in Transit
sub_items: TLS 1.2 minimum for all network communications (TLS 1.3 preferred)
VPN for remote access to internal networks

sections.heading: 4. Key Management
sub_items: Encryption keys stored in dedicated key management system (KMS)
Key rotation: annually minimum, immediately if compromised
Separation of duties between key custodians

sections.heading: 5. Prohibited
sub_items: No deprecated algorithms (DES, 3DES, RC4, MD5 for integrity)
No hardcoded keys in source code
No key transmission via unencrypted channels
